events.summary: Lisu 政变余部投降、Sardovia 与 Kesath 停火三天后，Ideth Vela 到 Citadel 的办公室与 Alaric Ossinast 会面。
events.quote: Three days after the surviving members of Lisu’s coup surrendered and Sardovia and Kesath declared a ceasefire, Ideth Vela met with Alaric Ossinast in the latter’s office at the Citadel.

events.summary: Alaric 把一份写明 Kesath 不肯让步事项的卷轴推到桌上，让 Vela 先与顾问过目。
events.quote: Alaric waited for Vela to nod before he placed a scroll on the desk and slid it closer to her.

events.summary: Vela 也提出 Sardovia 的不可谈判项——要求 Kesath 同样解除风暴船武装并归还领土，Alaric 当场答“Done”。
events.quote: We also demand disarmament of your stormships. And our lands returned to us.

events.summary: Vela 转述 Khaede 和自己的请求，想探望 Talasyn，Alaric 僵硬但应允，让她与 Nordaye 约时间。
events.quote: “Khaede and I would like to see Talasyn. If you are amenable.”

events.summary: 回医务室途中，来自东海岸的传信 skua 送来警讯，Alaric 命 Sevraim 寸步不离 Talasyn，自己乘狼形 coracle 赶去。
events.quote: On his way back to the infirmary, however, an unsettling report came in via messenger skua from the eastern coast.

events.summary: Alaric 在海滩上把手放在垂死的世界吞噬者 Bakun 鼻吻上，出声劝它撑住，又承认它必定很累了。
events.quote: Alaric tentatively rested a hand on Bakun’s snout. This was the leviathan that had nearly brought a dead season to Nenavar and the Continent, the same dangerous creature that had permanently scarred his face.

events.summary: Bakun 抬头，眼中 aether 最后一次闪亮，Alaric 告诉它会在 Sky Above the Sky 再见到 Talasyn。
events.quote: Bakun lifted his head, aether flaring briefly in its eyes. It was the last time that the light of the Voidfell would ever spark on Lir from its living source.

events.summary: Bakun 用尽余力长啸一声后滑入 Eversea 再未出现，Alaric 独自留在海滩落泪。
events.quote: The World-Eater slithered into the Eversea, never to emerge again. Alaric remained on the beach long after the waves had swallowed every last trace of it, beating against the shoreline in a salt-laced requiem.

relations.relation: 夫妻；她仍昏迷未醒，他急着回床边守着
relations.quote: “My wife is still unconscious. I must return to her posthaste.”

relations.relation: Sardovia 的 Amirante 与 Kesath 皇帝，停火后互递不可让步清单的和谈对手
relations.quote: “To business, then,” Vela agreed. “Why have I been summoned?”

relations.relation: 曾令 Nenavar 与大陆濒临死季、并永久毁去他面容的虚空巨龙，如今由他守在滩上送终
relations.quote: This was the leviathan that had nearly brought a dead season to Nenavar and the Continent, the same dangerous creature that had permanently scarred his face.

relations.relation: Talasyn 提前一千年唤醒 Bakun 以夺回 aethermancy，Bakun 因此耗尽性命
relations.quote: Elagbi had recounted to Alaric how Talasyn had woken Bakun up again—a thousand years ahead of schedule—in order to regain her aethermancy.

relations.relation: 父子；他在雨中落泪，也为他父亲而哭
relations.quote: Perhaps he wept also for his father—for what once was and what could have been.

numbers.context: Lisu 政变余部投降、两国宣布停火之后三天，Vela 与 Alaric 会面
numbers.quote: Three days after the surviving members of Lisu’s coup surrendered and Sardovia and Kesath declared a ceasefire

numbers.context: 双方约定两周后会面谈和约条款
numbers.quote: you and my officers agreed to meet in a fortnight’s time, to discuss the terms of the peace treaty

numbers.context: 世界吞噬者每千年只醒一夜的周期，被 Ishan Vaikar 称为一种夏眠
numbers.quote: the World-Eater’s cycle of waking only for one night every millennium was an estivation of sorts

numbers.value: a thousand years ahead of schedule
numbers.context: Talasyn 提前一千年把 Bakun 唤醒
numbers.quote: Talasyn had woken Bakun up again—a thousand years ahead of schedule—in order to regain her aethermancy

numbers.context: 这条古龙近几天消耗的能量无法持续，时间终于追上它
numbers.quote: The energy that the ancient dragon had expended over the last few days was unsustainable. Time had finally caught up with it.

notes: 源文首尾各有一行重复的 'Chapter Fifty-One' 标题（第1行与第12行），中间夹 10 个空行；正文从第15行开始。除该重复标题外无 OCR/断行异常，弯引号与 em dash（—）保持原样。
